narrative.overview: The public site is a shop's carbon-copy order book. Products are lines on a nota; every fact is pressed on as a rubber stamp; every village is a round cap desa seal in its own ink; ordering means writing a nota and sending it to the maker on WhatsApp.
keyCharacteristics: White order-book paper, blue rules, navy printed heads in Barlow Condensed caps.
Accent is stamp ink: platform violet, each village its own contrast-checked ink.
States and claims are stamps, never chips or badges.
Prices and quantities are tabular and right-aligned like a nota.
Carbon-copy tints (pink, yellow, blue) mark slips, notices, and sections.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: A page has one accent ink: violet on national pages, the village's own ink inside a village. Red and green are reserved for status stamps.

rules.name: The Book Is Navy Rule
rules.body: Structure (rules, column heads, sheet titles) is printed in navy, whatever the village ink. Village ink marks identity and action, never the ruling.

rules.name: The Printed Caps Rule
rules.body: Anything the book prints (heads, labels, stamps, buttons) is Barlow Condensed caps with positive tracking. Anything a person writes or reads at length is Barlow sentence case.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Prices are always tabular and right-aligned in the price column, formatted as IDR with formatRupiah.

rules.name: The Paper Is Flat Rule
rules.body: Sheets, rows, and stamps never cast shadows. Only an object physically lifted off the page (the slip, the seal on a photo) may.
